title: Libevent debug and count queries can invoke configured lock callbacks
why: event_get_events, event_get_priority, event_get_fd, event_get_base, event_get_callback, event_get_callback_arg and base count/priority queries cannot receive unconditional neutral custody declarations because their debug/setup or locking path can invoke configured lock callbacks. Discharge with a source-profile premise that excludes those callbacks and a checked configuration binding, or a richer callback effect with gateway and Lean parity, then pin every body variant and measure.

title: Review every selected backend and static-result relation for mk_event_backend
why: mk_event_backend dispatches to _mk_event_backend selected from five backend implementation files; review every selected body and static-result mode before a pinned declaration. This is distinct from the backend wait and registration residual in W46-EXTERNAL-RESIDUAL-RANKING.

title: Trace ID member aliases and ownership-replacing setters remain undeclared
why: ctr_id_get_buf returns cid->buf, a separate allocation whose lifetime is tied to the ID, not an interior pointer of cid. ctr_id_set releases and replaces that member. Other trace status/schema/ID/attribute setters can retain, replace or allocate reachable ownership. The scalar declarations do not model these effects. The baseline census records five ctr_id_get_buf and one ctr_id_set uncontracted-call leaves, none a sole blocker. Discharge with a member-owner lifetime and replacement relation, gateway refusal controls and audited Lean parity, then pin and remeasure the affected callers.

title: Metric logging and trace mpack helpers need explicit callback-effect premises
why: cmt_log_print can call cmt->log_cb; ctr_mpack_consume_* can reach mpack fill/error callbacks. Scalar returns do not establish custody neutrality on these paths. cmt_log_print has 43 uncontracted-call leaves in the archived baseline, none alone deciding a function. Discharge by expressing and enforcing the callback effects or a configuration premise that excludes those paths, with Rust controls and Lean parity, then record source pins and corpus measurements.
